notes.title: Thanks for playtesting!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We just wanted to really quickly thank everyone who chose to playtest Dog Clicker!

We ask if you have some time to fill out a quick survey just so we can learn on how to improve the game and what features users would want added!

[h2][url=https://forms.gle/d6itBajB3F2L7ohZA]Click here to fill out the survey.[/url][/h2]

Thank you everyone, and we can't wait to see you on January 6th!
